==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Burntmeat]] in the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]] kitchen.
|startmap = 2845,10056,plane:1
|difficulty = Experienced
|description = Trolls love goutweed. They love it so much that they've picked it all, and now they can't get any more. However, in his smelly kitchen in the Troll Stronghold, Burntmeat the cook has heard a rumour that goutweed is growing once again, for anyone who's got the skill to farm it. Can you teach his young assistant - a simple troll known as My Arm - to grow the precious goutweed? Will you overcome My Arm's stubbornness and ignorance to earn yourself Burntmeat's reward? Dare you accompany My Arm on this uniquely trollish expedition?
|length = Medium
|requirements = *{{SCP|Farming|29|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} {{Questreqstart|}}
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|10|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}}  {{Questreqstart|}} <ref>Needed to cut thatches and repair the fence for Tai Bwo Wannai favour, otherwise you will have to kill monsters spawned by other players (or nearby jungle spiders)</ref>
*Completion of the following quests:
**[[Eadgar's Ruse]]
***[[Druidic Ritual]]
***[[Troll Stronghold]]
****[[Death Plateau]]
**[[The Feud]]
**[[Jungle Potion]]
*At least 60% favour in the [[Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup]] [[minigame]] before starting this quest - this will be subtracted from the total favour
**Acquiring 100% Tai Bwo Favour rating is a requirement for the [[Medium Karamja Diary]]. If completion of the medium diary is desired, it is recommended to get 100% prior to starting this quest
|items = *[[Bucket]] (can be obtained during the quest, south of the cooking pot on [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]])
*3 [[Ugthanki dung]], or the following materials to gather it:
**[[Red hot sauce]] (obtainable in [[Pollnivneach]]) '''or''' the [[Camulet]] (from [[Enakhra's Lament]] quest)
**[[Spade]]
**3 additional [[bucket]]s
*Several farming supplies, which can be stored by any [[Tool Leprechaun]] and withdrawn from the [[Tool Leprechaun (Larry)|Trollheim Tool Leprechaun]]. He sells all of these '''except''' for supercompost:
**7 [[Supercompost]] (must be ''super''compost; one extra can be used instead of plant cure, making 8 total) Note: Bottomless compost bucket will not work, even one that is containing supercompost.
**[[Spade]] (To give to [[My Arm]] temporarily; he will return it near the end of the quest)
**[[Rake]] (To give to [[My Arm]] temporarily; he will return it near the end of the quest)
**[[Seed dibber]] (To give to [[My Arm]] temporarily; he will return it near the end of the quest. This is still needed even if Barbarian Training is completed)
**[[Plant cure]] (disease can be avoided with an additional supercompost but the plant can get diseased during a cutscene right after planting so plant cure is still recommended)
*[[Climbing boots]] (can be bought from [[Tenzing]] for 12 coins)
|recommended = *{{SCP|Combat|55|link=yes}}
*{{SCP|Prayer|43|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} for [[Protection prayers]]
*{{SCP|Magic|61|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} for [[Trollheim Teleport]]
*Fast travel to Al Kharid ([[ring of dueling]] or [[amulet of glory]]) or Pollnivneach ([[Pollnivneach Teleport]] or coins to use the [[magic carpet system]]) to obtain Ugthanki Dung 
*Fast travel to [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]] ([[games necklace]] to Burthorpe or [[combat bracelet]] to the [[Warriors' Guild]])
*[[Stamina potion|Stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s
*Food, [[armour]], and a [[weapon]]
* A Machete if you have less than 60% favour in the [[Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup]] [[minigame]]
|kills = *[[Baby Roc]] ''(level 75)''
*[[Giant Roc]] ''(level 172)''
